subject: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.s@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial

Hi Alex / Priya 

Great to meet earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get FinCo's evaluation running on Redwood: 

1) Dataset: You mentioned a 2k record set of anonymized customer support transcripts + classification labels (intent + severity). Please send the CSV in the schema we discussed (columns: id, text, label_intent, label_severity).

2) Eval goals: Primary is classification accuracy on intent (macro F1), secondary is latency under 95th percentile SLO (per-request). Also want a basic hallucination checklist for open responses.

3) Recommended models: For quick iterations we propose trying open LLM variants we host: Llama-2-70b-instruct-8k-quant and Redwyn-13b-quant (cost vs. quality sweep). We'll also run a baseline on a smaller 7B to validate throughput.

4) Scoring and prompts: We'll share a prompt set + scoring rubric. If you have any gold labels that use multi-intent, flag them and we'll handle mapping.

5) Timeline: If we get the dataset by EOD Thu (Dec 3), we can provision an eval workspace and deliver first pass results by Wed Dec 9.

Attachments: I attached the eval template and example CSV header (finco-eval-dataset.csv, redwood-eval-template.md).

Next step: Can you confirm dataset delivery date and whether there are any privacy/PII constraints?

Thanks 
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.s@finco.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 11:40:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial

Thanks Marissa  this is helpful. A couple quick answers: 

- We can get you a 2k anonymized CSV by Friday (Dec 4) EOD; legal is reviewing but no expected delays.
- For labels: intent is single-label, severity is low/med/high. We do have a small set (~200) of edge cases with multi-intent; we can flag them in a separate column.
- On scoring: the PO wants to see both macro F1 and confusion matrix for the top 10 intents. Latency SLO is a must.

One ask: for the hallucination checklist, can you confirm whether Redwood will run any open-generation tests against our support answers, or will you only evaluate classification? We may want both.

Appreciate the timeline  Friday delivery should work.

Regards,
Alex
Head of Product
FinCo
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial

Team  forwarding FinCo's confirmation. Can you help provision an eval workspace and outline the minimal config we need to run the sweep below? Highlights: 

- Dataset: finco-eval-dataset.csv (2k rows). Schema: id,text,label_intent,label_severity,edge_case_flag.
- Models to run: redwyn-13b-quant (quality), llama-2-70b-instruct-8k-quant (quality+hallucination), red-7b-quant (throughput baseline).
- Metrics: macro F1 (intent), top-10 confusion matrix export, average latency and p95 latency per model, and a hallucination checklist for any open-response outputs.
- Scoring rubric: threshold of 0.75 macro F1 for intent to be considered acceptable on first pass.
- Deliverables: raw predictions CSV per model, evaluation dashboard link, brief summary doc with recommendations.

Can we also add: a prompt set for classification + 20 open-generation prompts for hallucination sampling? I'll upload prompt_set_v1 in Drive (link below). 

Target: first-pass results by Dec 9 if dataset arrives by Dec 4. Please advise if GPU capacity or quant profiles need manual tuning.

Thanks 
Marissa

(Attachment: redwood-eval-template.md stub)
From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 16:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial

Sounds good  we can provision an eval workspace in the Redwood console for FinCo and spin up the three model runs. Plan and notes: 

- Workspace & access: I will create a project "FinCo-eval-DEAL-8492" and invite Marissa + Alex (external invite link) once dataset is uploaded to our secure S3. We'll use dedicated ephemeral tokens scoped to the project.
- Dataset ingestion: Expect CSV ingestion to validate schema and surface errors. Edge-case flagged rows will get routed to a separate bucket for manual review.
- Models & config: we'll run the three models with the following runtime profiles: 13b-quant (standard), 70b-instruct-8k-quant (high-memory, p95 tuned), 7b-quant (batched throughput). I'll set quant profiles to the defaults we use for evals unless you want experimental kernels.
- Scoring: We'll compute macro F1 and per-class precision/recall. I'll also export a confusion matrix PNG and a raw predictions CSV. For hallucination checks, we'll sample 20 open prompts (provided by Marissa) and run both generation + grounding heuristics.
- Timeline: If dataset lands by EOD Fri (Dec 4), infra provisioning and a smoke run will be done by Mon Dec 7; full sweep results by Wed Dec 9 (as requested). If legal requires special handling, ping me and I'll enable private deployment flags.

Attachments: none. Links: prompt set location (Drive) and HubSpot deal.

I'll follow up with the console project link once ready.

Thanks,
Dev
Senior Infra Engineer
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@finco.com>
Cc: Priya Suresh <priya.s@finco.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 2 Dec 2026 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Next steps: Model evals and dataset for Redwood trial

Alex  thanks for the quick turnaround and for confirming Friday delivery. I wanted to confirm the plan and share the links we'll use for the evaluation: 

- Eval template & dataset header: https://drive.google.com/file/d/redwood-eval-template
- Prompt set (classification + 20 open-generation prompts): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-evals (prompt_set_v1.pdf inside)
- HubSpot deal tracker: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/8492

What we'll do after you upload: Dev will create the project and run a smoke test (small subset) to validate ingestion/schema. Then we'll run the three-model sweep and deliver: predictions.csv (per model), metrics summary (macro F1, per-intent confusion), latency report (avg + p95), and hallucination sampling results. If anything looks off on the smoke test, we'll pause and iterate on prompts/label mapping.

Action items for FinCo: 
- Upload anonymized CSV to the secure S3 location (I'll share an upload token once Dev provisions the project).
- Mark the edge cases with edge_case_flag=1 where applicable.
- Let us know if any rows contain PII that requires additional handling.

We'll aim to have first-pass results by Dec 9. If you'd like a call after the results to walk through the dashboard, I'm happy to schedule.

Best,
Marissa
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
(Attachments referenced: finco-eval-dataset.csv, redwood-eval-template.md)
